sent_bad: According to `doc.txt`, satisfaction with customer service interactions drops during the holiday season for two related reasons:

Retailers bring in 20–40% of their annual sales in the weeks leading up to Christmas, and the Zendesk Benchmark found a clear correlation between the drop in satisfaction and the number of tickets per agent: as tickets per agent increased, satisfaction decreased.

The document frames this as the "holiday dip": a measurable, consistent decline in satisfaction during Q4, driven by the combination of strained capacity (more tickets per agent) and a harder-to-serve customer base.
